def Shape := List Nat

namespace Shape

def nil : Shape := []

def cons (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : Shape := d :: s

def dims : Shape → List Nat := id

def length (s : Shape) : Nat := s.length

def get? (s : Shape) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := s.get? i

def getD (s : Shape) (i : Nat) (default : Nat) : Nat := s.getD i default

def set (s : Shape) (i : Nat) (d : Nat) : Shape := s.set i d

theorem length_nil : length nil = 0 := rfl

theorem length_cons (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : length (cons d s) = length s + 1 := rfl

theorem dims_nil : dims nil = [] := rfl

theorem dims_cons (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : dims (cons d s) = d :: dims s := rfl

theorem get?_nil (i : Nat) : get? nil i = none := rfl

theorem get?_cons_zero (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : get? (cons d s) 0 = some d := rfl

theorem get?_cons_succ (d : Nat) (s : Shape) (i : Nat) : get? (cons d s) (i + 1) = get? s i := rfl

theorem getD_nil (i : Nat) (default : Nat) : getD nil i default = default := rfl

theorem getD_cons_zero (d : Nat) (s : Shape) (default : Nat) : getD (cons d s) 0 default = d := rfl

theorem getD_cons_succ (d : Nat) (s : Shape) (i : Nat) (default : Nat) : getD (cons d s) (i + 1) default = getD s i default := rfl

def totalSize : Shape → Nat
  | [] => 1
  | d :: ds => d * totalSize ds

theorem totalSize_nil : totalSize nil = 1 := rfl

theorem totalSize_cons (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : totalSize (cons d s) = d * totalSize s := rfl

theorem totalSize_cons_eq (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : totalSize (d :: s) = d * totalSize s := rfl

theorem totalSize_singleton (d : Nat) : totalSize [d] = d := by simp [totalSize]

theorem totalSize_two (d1 d2 : Nat) : totalSize [d1, d2] = d1 * d2 := by simp [totalSize]

theorem totalSize_three (d1 d2 d3 : Nat) : totalSize [d1, d2, d3] = d1 * d2 * d3 := by simp [totalSize]

theorem totalSize_append (s1 s2 : Shape) : totalSize (s1 ++ s2) = totalSize s1 * totalSize s2 := by
  induction s1 with
  | nil => simp [totalSize]
  | cons d ds ih => simp [totalSize, ih, mul_assoc]

theorem totalSize_reverse (s : Shape) : totalSize s.reverse = totalSize s := by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [totalSize]
  | cons d ds ih => simp [totalSize, List.reverse_cons, totalSize_append, ih, mul_comm]

theorem totalSize_eq_one_of_nil (s : Shape) (h : s = nil) : totalSize s = 1 := by simp [h, totalSize]

theorem totalSize_eq_mul_of_cons (s : Shape) (d : Nat) (h : s = cons d (tail s)) : totalSize s = d * totalSize (tail s) := by
  cases s
  case nil => simp at h
  case cons head tail => simp [totalSize]

def strides : Shape → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | d :: ds =>
    let s := strides ds
    let ts := totalSize ds
    ts :: s

theorem strides_nil : strides nil = [] := rfl

theorem strides_cons (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : strides (cons d s) = totalSize s :: strides s := rfl

theorem strides_length (s : Shape) : (strides s).length = s.length := by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [strides]
  | cons d ds ih => simp [strides, ih]

theorem strides_get?_zero (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : (strides (cons d s)).get? 0 = some (totalSize s) := rfl

theorem strides_get?_succ (d : Nat) (s : Shape) (i : Nat) : (strides (cons d s)).get? (i + 1) = (strides s).get? i := rfl

theorem strides_head_eq_totalSize_tail (d : Nat) (s : Shape) : (strides (d :: s)).head? = some (totalSize s) := rfl

def stridesProd (s : Shape) : Nat :=
  let sp := strides s
  let ts := totalSize s
  ts

theorem stridesProd_eq_totalSize (s : Shape) : stridesProd s = totalSize s := rfl

def equals (s1 s2 : Shape) : Bool := s1 == s2

theorem equals_refl (s : Shape) : equals s s = true := by simp [equals]

theorem equals_symm (s1 s2 : Shape) : equals s1 s2 = equals s2 s1 := by simp [equals, Bool.eq_comm]

theorem equals_trans (s1 s2 s3 : Shape) (h1 : equals s1 s2 = true) (h2 : equals s2 s3 = true) : equals s1 s3 = true := by
  simp [equals] at *
  rw [h1, h2]

theorem equals_nil_nil : equals nil nil = true := rfl

theorem equals_cons_cons (d1 d2 : Nat) (s1 s2 : Shape) : equals (cons d1 s1) (cons d2 s2) = (d1 == d2 && equals s1 s2) := by
  simp [equals, cons]

def broadcastCompatible (source target : Shape) : Bool :=
  let offset := target.length - source.length
  if offset > target.length then false
  else
    let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool :=
      if i < source.length then
        let source_dim := source.getD i 1
        let target_dim := target.getD (offset + i) 1
        if source_dim == target_dim || source_dim == 1 then
          check (i + 1)
        else
          false
      else
        true
    check 0

theorem broadcastCompatible_nil_target (target : Shape) : broadcastCompatible nil target = true := by
  simp [broadcastCompatible]
  let offset := target.length - 0
  simp [offset]
  let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool := if i < 0 then false else true
  simp [check]

theorem broadcastCompatible_source_longer (source target : Shape) (h : source.length > target.length) : broadcastCompatible source target = false := by
  simp [broadcastCompatible]
  let offset := target.length - source.length
  have : offset > target.length := by
    simp [offset]
    omega
  simp [this]

def isContiguous (s : Shape) : Bool :=
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i = 0 then
      true
    else
      let idx := i - 1
      let stride := (strides s).getD idx 0
      if stride == expected then
        check idx (expected * (s.getD idx 1))
      else
        false
  check s.length 1

theorem isContiguous_nil : isContiguous nil = true := by
  simp [isContiguous]
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool := if i = 0 then true else false
  simp [check]

theorem isContiguous_singleton (d : Nat) : isContiguous [d] = true := by
  simp [isContiguous, strides]
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i = 0 then true
    else
      let idx := i - 1
      let stride := ([1]).getD idx 0
      if stride == expected then check idx (expected * ([d].getD idx 1)) else false
  simp [check]
  decide

def init (shape : Shape) : Shape := shape

theorem init_eq_id (shape : Shape) : init shape = shape := rfl

def copy (s : Shape) : Shape := s

theorem copy_eq (s : Shape) : copy s = s := rfl

def deinit (s : Shape) : Shape := nil

theorem deinit_eq_nil (s : Shape) : deinit s = nil := rfl

end Shape

structure Tensor where
  data : Array Float

namespace Tensor

instance : Inhabited Tensor := ⟨⟨#[0], []⟩⟩

def dataSize (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.data.size

theorem dataSize_eq_totalSize (t : Tensor) : t.dataSize = t.shape.totalSize := by
  sorry

def init (shape : Shape) (init_val : Float := 0.0) : Tensor :=
  let size := shape.totalSize
  let data := Array.mkArray size init_val
  ⟨data, shape⟩

theorem init_data_size (shape : Shape) (init_val : Float) : (init shape init_val).dataSize = shape.totalSize := by
  simp [init, dataSize]

theorem init_data_get (shape : Shape) (init_val : Float) (i : Nat) (h : i < shape.totalSize) : (init shape init_val).data.get ⟨i, by simpa [init] using h⟩ = init_val := by
  simp [init]
  exact Array.get_mkArray _ _ _

theorem init_shape (shape : Shape) (init_val : Float) : (init shape init_val).shape = shape := rfl

def zeros (shape : Shape) : Tensor := init shape 0.0

theorem zeros_data_size (shape : Shape) : (zeros shape).dataSize = shape.totalSize := by
  simp [zeros, init_data_size]

theorem zeros_data_get (shape : Shape) (i : Nat) (h : i < shape.totalSize) : (zeros shape).data.get ⟨i, by simpa [zeros] using h⟩ = 0.0 := by
  simp [zeros]
  exact init_data_get shape 0.0 i h

theorem zeros_shape (shape : Shape) : (zeros shape).shape = shape := rfl

def ones (shape : Shape) : Tensor := init shape 1.0

theorem ones_data_size (shape : Shape) : (ones shape).dataSize = shape.totalSize := by
  simp [ones, init_data_size]

theorem ones_data_get (shape : Shape) (i : Nat) (h : i < shape.totalSize) : (ones shape).data.get ⟨i, by simpa [ones] using h⟩ = 1.0 := by
  simp [ones]
  exact init_data_get shape 1.0 i h

theorem ones_shape (shape : Shape) : (ones shape).shape = shape := rfl

def full (shape : Shape) (value : Float) : Tensor := init shape value

theorem full_data_size (shape : Shape) (value : Float) : (full shape value).dataSize = shape.totalSize := by
  simp [full, init_data_size]

theorem full_data_get (shape : Shape) (value : Float) (i : Nat) (h : i < shape.totalSize) : (full shape value).data.get ⟨i, by simpa [full] using h⟩ = value := by
  simp [full]
  exact init_data_get shape value i h

theorem full_shape (shape : Shape) (value : Float) : (full shape value).shape = shape := rfl

def copy (t : Tensor) : Tensor := ⟨t.data.copy, t.shape⟩

theorem copy_data_eq (t : Tensor) : (copy t).data = t.data.copy := rfl

theorem copy_shape_eq (t : Tensor) : (copy t).shape = t.shape := rfl

def fill (t : Tensor) (value : Float) : Tensor :=
  let data' := t.data.map (fun _ => value)
  ⟨data', t.shape⟩

theorem fill_data_size (t : Tensor) (value : Float) : (fill t value).dataSize = t.dataSize := by
  simp [fill, dataSize]

  simp [fill]
  have : i < t.data.size := by simpa [dataSize] using h
  simp [Array.get_map]
  simp

def computeIndex (shape : Shape) (indices : List Nat) : Except TensorError Nat :=
  if indices.length != shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let rec compute (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) : Except TensorError Nat :=
      if i < shape.length then
        let idx := indices.getD i 0
        let dim := shape.getD i 1
        let stride := (Shape.strides shape).getD i 0
        if idx < dim then
          compute (i + 1) (acc + idx * stride)
        else
          Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds
      else
        Except.ok acc
    compute 0 0

theorem computeIndex_nil_nil : computeIndex [] [] = Except.ok 0 := by
  simp [computeIndex]
  let rec compute (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) : Except TensorError Nat :=
    if i < 0 then Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds else Except.ok acc
  simp [compute]

theorem computeIndex_invalidAxis (shape : Shape) (indices : List Nat) (h : indices.length != shape.length) : computeIndex shape indices = Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis := by
  simp [computeIndex, h]

theorem computeIndex_outOfBounds (shape : Shape) (indices : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : indices.getD i 0 >= shape.getD i 1) : computeIndex shape indices = Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds := by
  simp [computeIndex]

def get (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) : Except TensorError Float :=
  match computeIndex t.shape indices with
  | Except.ok idx =>
    if h : idx < t.data.size then
      Except.ok (t.data.get ⟨idx, h⟩)
    else
      Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

theorem get_ok (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (idx : Nat) (h : computeIndex t.shape indices = Except.ok idx) (hidx : idx < t.data.size) : get t indices = Except.ok (t.data.get ⟨idx, hidx⟩) := by
  simp [get, h]

theorem get_error_computeIndex (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (e : TensorError) (h : computeIndex t.shape indices = Except.error e) : get t indices = Except.error e := by
  simp [get, h]

def set (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (value : Float) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match computeIndex t.shape indices with
  | Except.ok idx =>
    if h : idx < t.data.size then
      Except.ok ⟨t.data.set ⟨idx, h⟩ value, t.shape⟩
    else
      Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

theorem set_ok (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (idx : Nat) (value : Float) (h : computeIndex t.shape indices = Except.ok idx) (hidx : idx < t.data.size) : set t indices value = Except.ok ⟨t.data.set ⟨idx, hidx⟩ value, t.shape⟩ := by
  simp [set, h]

theorem set_error_computeIndex (t : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (value : Float) (e : TensorError) (h : computeIndex t.shape indices = Except.error e) : set t indices value = Except.error e := by
  simp [set, h]

def reshape (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if new_shape.length == 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidShape
  else if t.shape.totalSize != new_shape.totalSize then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidShape
  else
    Except.ok ⟨t.data, new_shape⟩

theorem reshape_ok (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) (h1 : new_shape.length > 0) (h2 : t.shape.totalSize = new_shape.totalSize) : reshape t new_shape = Except.ok ⟨t.data, new_shape⟩ := by
  simp [reshape, h1, h2]

theorem reshape_error_empty (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) (h : new_shape.length == 0) : reshape t new_shape = Except.error TensorError.invalidShape := by
  simp [reshape, h]

theorem reshape_error_size (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) (h : t.shape.totalSize != new_shape.totalSize) : reshape t new_shape = Except.error TensorError.invalidShape := by
  simp [reshape]
  split_ifs
  case pos.cases => simp
  case neg.cases => simp [h]

def view (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) : Except TensorError Tensor := reshape t new_shape

theorem view_eq_reshape (t : Tensor) (new_shape : Shape) : view t new_shape = reshape t new_shape := rfl

def add (a b : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if !a.shape.equals b.shape then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let data' := a.data.zipWith (· + ·) b.data
    Except.ok ⟨data', a.shape⟩

theorem add_ok (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b.shape = true) : add a b = Except.ok ⟨a.data.zipWith (· + ·) b.data, a.shape⟩ := by
  simp [add, h]

theorem add_error_shapeMismatch (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b.shape = false) : add a b = Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch := by
  simp [add, h]

theorem add_data_size (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b shape = true) : (add a b).get?.dataSize = a.dataSize := by
  simp [add, h, dataSize]
  sorry

  if !a.shape.equals b.shape then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let data' := a.data.zipWith (· - ·) b.data
    Except.ok ⟨data', a.shape⟩

theorem sub_ok (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b.shape = true) : sub a b = Except.ok ⟨a.data.zipWith (· - ·) b.data, a.shape⟩ := by
  simp [sub, h]

  simp [sub, h]

    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let data' := a.data.zipWith (· * ·) b.data

theorem mul_ok (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b.shape = true) : mul a b = Except.ok ⟨a.data.zipWith (· * ·) b.data, a.shape⟩ := by

  if a.shape.length != 1 || b.shape.length != 1 then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := b.shape.getD 0 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      a.data.getD i 0.0 * b.data.getD j 0.0

    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [m, n]⟩

  if t.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let m := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      t.data.getD (j * m + i) 0.0
    )
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [n, m]⟩

def matmul (a b : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if a.shape.length != 2 || b.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else if a.shape.getD 1 0 != b.shape.getD 0 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.getD 0 0
    let k := a.shape.getD 1 0
    let n := b.shape.getD 1 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      (List.range k).foldl (fun acc l =>
        let a_val := a.data.getD (i * k + l) 0.0
        let b_val := b.data.getD (l * n + j) 0.0
        acc + a_val * b_val
      ) 0.0
    )
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [m, n]⟩

    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => 0.0)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => Float.negInfinity)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => Float.infinity)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def mean (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match t.sum axis with
  | Except.ok s =>
    let dim := Float.ofNat (t.shape.getD axis 0)
    divScalar s dim
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def variance (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=

    match diff with

      | Except.error e => Except.error e

def stddev (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match t.variance axis with
  | Except.ok v => Except.ok (sqrt v)
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def softmax (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=

    | Except.error err => Except.error err

  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare

    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0

    Except.ok result

def det (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Float :=

  else

def inverse (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=

    let data := Array.mkArray size 0.0
    Except.ok ⟨data, target_shape⟩

def unsqueeze (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis > t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else

    broadcast t new_shape

def slice (t : Tensor) (starts ends : List Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if starts.length != t.shape.length || ends.length != t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>

    )
    let size := new_shape.totalSize
    let data := Array.mkArray size 0.0
    Except.ok ⟨data, new_shape⟩

  if tensors.isEmpty then
    Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  else match tensors.head? with
  | none => Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  | some first =>
    if axis >= first.shape.length then
      Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
    else
      let total_axis := tensors.foldl (fun acc t => acc + t.shape.getD axis 0) 0
      let new_shape := first.shape.set axis total_axis
      Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def stack (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then
    Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  else match tensors.head? with
  | none => Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  | some first =>
    if axis > first.shape.length then
      Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
    else
      let new_shape := first.shape.insert axis tensors.length
      Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def pad (t : Tensor) (pads : List (Nat × Nat)) : Except TensorError Tensor :=

    Except.error TensorError.invalidPads
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>

    )
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def tile (t : Tensor) (reps : List Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if reps.length != t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidReps
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>

    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    Except.ok t

def unique (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  Except.ok t

def oneHot (t : Tensor) (num_classes : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 1 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidForOneHot
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let new_shape := [n, num_classes]
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray (n * num_classes) 0.0, new_shape⟩

  Except.ok ⟨data, t.shape⟩

def conv2d (t : Tensor) (kernel : Tensor) (stride padding : Nat × Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 4 || kernel.shape.length != 4 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidConv2D
  else
    let batch := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let in_h := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let in_w := t.shape.getD 2 0
    let in_c := t.shape.getD 3 0
    let k_h := kernel.shape.getD 0 0
    let k_w := kernel.shape.getD 1 0
    let out_c := kernel.shape.getD 3 0
    let out_h := (in_h + 2 * padding.1 - k_h) / stride.1 + 1
    let out_w := (in_w + 2 * padding.2 - k_w) / stride.2 + 1
    let new_shape := [batch, out_h, out_w, out_c]
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

    let n := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let q := identity m

    Except.ok (q, r)

    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray (n * n) 0.0, [n, n]⟩

def broadcastCompatible (source target : Shape) : Bool :=
  let offset := target.length - source.length
  if offset > target.length then false
  else
    let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool :=
      if i < source.length then
        let source_dim := source.getD i 1
        let target_dim := target.getD (offset + i) 1
        if source_dim == target_dim || source_dim == 1 then
          check (i + 1)
        else
          false
      else
        true
    check 0

  simp [broadcastCompatible]
  let offset := target.length - 0
  simp [offset]
  let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool := if i < 0 then false else true
  simp [check]

  simp [broadcastCompatible]
  let offset := target.length - source.length
  have : offset > target.length := by
    simp [offset]
    omega
  simp [this]

def isContiguous (s : Shape) : Bool :=
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i = 0 then
      true
    else
      let idx := i - 1
      let stride := (strides s).getD idx 0
      if stride == expected then
        check idx (expected * (s.getD idx 1))
      else
        false
  check s.length 1

theorem isContiguous_nil : isContiguous nil = true := by
  simp [isContiguous]
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool := if i = 0 then true else false
  simp [check]

theorem isContiguous_singleton (d : Nat) : isContiguous [d] = true := by
  simp [isContiguous, strides]
  let rec check (i : Nat) (expected : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i = 0 then true
    else
      let idx := i - 1
      let stride := ([1]).getD idx 0
      if stride == expected then check idx (expected * ([d].getD idx 1)) else false
  simp [check]
  decide

  if indices.length != shape.length then

      if i < shape.length then
        let idx := indices.getD i 0
        let dim := shape.getD i 1
        let stride := (Shape.strides shape).getD i 0
        if idx < dim then
          compute (i + 1) (acc + idx * stride)
        else
          Except.error TensorError.outOfBounds
      else
        Except.ok acc
    compute 0 0

def arange (start stop step : Float) : Tensor :=
  let size := Float.ceil ((stop - start) / step).toNat
  let size := if size > 0 then size else 0
  let data := (List.range size).map (fun i => start + step * Float.ofNat i)
  ⟨data.toArray, [size]⟩

def linspace (start stop : Float) (num : Nat) : Tensor :=
  if num == 0 then
    ⟨#[], [0]⟩
  else if num == 1 then
    ⟨#[stop], [1]⟩
  else
    let step := (stop - start) / (Float.ofNat (num - 1))
    let data := (List.range num).map (fun i => start + step * Float.ofNat i)
    ⟨data.toArray, [num]⟩

def equals (a b : Tensor) : Bool :=
  a.shape == b.shape && a.data == b.data

theorem equals_refl (a : Tensor) : equals a a = true := by
  simp [equals]

theorem equals_symm (a b : Tensor) : equals a b = equals b a := by
  simp [equals, Bool.and_comm]

def isClose (a b : Tensor) (rtol atol : Float) : Bool :=
  if !a.shape.equals b.shape then false
  else
    a.data.zipWith (fun x y =>
      let diff := Float.abs (x - y)
      diff <= atol + rtol * Float.abs y
    ) b.data |>.all id

def normL2 (t : Tensor) : Float :=
  t.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 |>. Float.sqrt

def dot (a b : Tensor) : Except TensorError Float :=
  if a.dataSize != b.dataSize then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    Except.ok (a.data.zipWith (· * ·) b.data |>.foldl (· + ·) 0.0)

theorem dot_ok (a b : Tensor) (h : a.dataSize = b.dataSize) : dot a b = Except.ok (a.data.zipWith (· * ·) b.data |>.foldl (· + ·) 0.0) := by
  simp [dot, h]

theorem dot_error (a b : Tensor) (h : a.dataSize != b.dataSize) : dot a b = Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch := by
  simp [dot, h]

def outer (a b : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if a.shape.length != 1 || b.shape.length != 1 then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := b.shape.getD 0 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      a.data.getD i 0.0 * b.data.getD j 0.0
    )
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [m, n]⟩

def transpose (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let m := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      t.data.getD (j * m + i) 0.0
    )
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [n, m]⟩

def matmul (a b : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if a.shape.length != 2 || b.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else if a.shape.getD 1 0 != b.shape.getD 0 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.getD 0 0
    let k := a.shape.getD 1 0
    let n := b.shape.getD 1 0
    let data := (List.range (m * n)).map (fun idx =>
      let i := idx / n
      let j := idx % n
      (List.range k).foldl (fun acc l =>
        let a_val := a.data.getD (i * k + l) 0.0
        let b_val := b.data.getD (l * n + j) 0.0
        acc + a_val * b_val
      ) 0.0
    )
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, [m, n]⟩

def sum (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => 0.0)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def max (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => Float.negInfinity)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def min (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => Float.infinity)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def mean (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match t.sum axis with
  | Except.ok s =>
    let dim := Float.ofNat (t.shape.getD axis 0)
    divScalar s dim
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def variance (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match t.mean axis with
  | Except.ok m =>
    let expanded_m := m
    let diff := sub t expanded_m
    match diff with
    | Except.ok d =>
      let sq := mul d d
      match sq with
      | Except.ok s => mean s axis
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def stddev (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  match t.variance axis with
  | Except.ok v => Except.ok (sqrt v)
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def softmax (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let max_t := max t axis
    match max_t with
    | Except.ok m =>
      let sub_t := sub t m
      match sub_t with
      | Except.ok s =>
        let exp_t := exp s
        match exp_t with
        | Except.ok e =>
          let sum_t := sum e axis
          match sum_t with
          | Except.ok sm => div e sm
          | Except.error err => Except.error err
        | Except.error err => Except.error err
      | Except.error err => Except.error err
    | Except.error err => Except.error err

def argmax (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => 0.0)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def argmin (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let dim := t.shape.getD axis 0
    let new_shape := t.shape.set axis 1
    let total := t.shape.totalSize
    let data := (List.range (total / dim)).map (fun _ => 0.0)
    Except.ok ⟨data.toArray, new_shape⟩

def trace (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Float :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let result := (List.range n).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc + t.data.getD (i * n + i) 0.0
    ) 0.0
    Except.ok result

def det (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Float :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    Except.ok 1.0

def inverse (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let id := identity n
    Except.ok id

def broadcast (t : Tensor) (target_shape : Shape) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if !t.shape.broadcastCompatible target_shape then
    Except.error TensorError.shapeMismatch
  else
    let size := target_shape.totalSize
    let data := Array.mkArray size 0.0
    Except.ok ⟨data, target_shape⟩

def unsqueeze (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis > t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let new_shape := t.shape.insert axis 1
    broadcast t new_shape

def slice (t : Tensor) (starts ends : List Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if starts.length != t.shape.length || ends.length != t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>
      ends.getD i 0 - starts.getD i 0
    )
    let size := new_shape.totalSize
    let data := Array.mkArray size 0.0
    Except.ok ⟨data, new_shape⟩

def concat (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then
    Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  else match tensors.head? with
  | none => Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  | some first =>
    if axis >= first.shape.length then
      Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
    else
      let total_axis := tensors.foldl (fun acc t => acc + t.shape.getD axis 0) 0
      let new_shape := first.shape.set axis total_axis
      Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def stack (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then
    Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  else match tensors.head? with
  | none => Except.error TensorError.emptyInput
  | some first =>
    if axis > first.shape.length then
      Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
    else
      let new_shape := first.shape.insert axis tensors.length
      Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def pad (t : Tensor) (pads : List (Nat × Nat)) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if pads.length != t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidPads
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>
      let (lo, hi) := pads.getD i (0, 0)
      t.shape.getD i 0 + lo + hi
    )
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def tile (t : Tensor) (reps : List Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if reps.length != t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidReps
  else
    let new_shape := (List.range t.shape.length).map (fun i =>
      t.shape.getD i 0 * reps.getD i 1
    )
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def sort (t : Tensor) (axis : Nat) (descending : Bool) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if axis >= t.shape.length then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    Except.ok t

def unique (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  Except.ok t

def oneHot (t : Tensor) (num_classes : Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 1 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidForOneHot
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let new_shape := [n, num_classes]
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray (n * num_classes) 0.0, new_shape⟩

def toInt (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  let data := t.data.map Float.floor
  Except.ok ⟨data, t.shape⟩

def conv2d (t : Tensor) (kernel : Tensor) (stride padding : Nat × Nat) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 4 || kernel.shape.length != 4 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidConv2D
  else
    let batch := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let in_h := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let in_w := t.shape.getD 2 0
    let in_c := t.shape.getD 3 0
    let k_h := kernel.shape.getD 0 0
    let k_w := kernel.shape.getD 1 0
    let out_c := kernel.shape.getD 3 0
    let out_h := (in_h + 2 * padding.1 - k_h) / stride.1 + 1
    let out_w := (in_w + 2 * padding.2 - k_w) / stride.2 + 1
    let new_shape := [batch, out_h, out_w, out_c]
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray new_shape.totalSize 0.0, new_shape⟩

def qr (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let m := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let q := identity m
    let r := t
    Except.ok (q, r)

def lu (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let l := identity n
    let u := t
    Except.ok (l, u)

def cholesky (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError Tensor :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    Except.ok ⟨Array.mkArray (n * n) 0.0, [n, n]⟩

def eig (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 || t.shape.getD 0 0 != t.shape.getD 1 0 then
    Except.error TensorError.mustBeSquare
  else
    let n := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let vals := ⟨Array.mkArray n 0.0, [n]⟩
    let vecs := identity n
    Except.ok (vals, vecs)

def svd (t : Tensor) : Except TensorError (Tensor × Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if t.shape.length != 2 then
    Except.error TensorError.invalidAxis
  else
    let m := t.shape.getD 0 0
    let n := t.shape.getD 1 0
    let u := ⟨Array.mkArray (m * m) 0.0, [m, m]⟩
    let s := ⟨Array.mkArray (min m n) 0.0, [min m n]⟩
    let v := ⟨Array.mkArray (n * n) 0.0, [n, n]⟩
    Except.ok (u, s, v)

def spectralNorm (t : Tensor) (max_iter : Nat) (tol : Float) : Except TensorError Float :=

Ez a kód nem „valós formális verifikáció” a jelenlegi állapotában, hanem inkább egy *részben bizonyított / részben placeholder* (mock) Lean4/mathlib váz, mert több helyen ténylegesen hiányzik a bizonyítás (`sorry`), és van több olyan definíciós/névhasználati hiba is, ami miatt le sem fordulna, így formális bizonyítási értéke ezek kijavítása nélkül nincs.[1][2]

## Miért nem formális verifikáció?
A `sorry` Leanben azt jelenti, hogy az adott állítást axiómaként elfogadod bizonyítás nélkül, tehát onnantól az egész fejlesztés „lyukas”: a későbbi tételek ugyan típushelyesen épülhetnek rá, de nem garantálják a tényleges igazságot.[1]

Nálad például ilyen lyuk a `dataSize_eq_totalSize` és több további lemma is (pl. `add_data_size`, `addScalar_data_get`), tehát a könyvtár nem zárt, nem teljesen gépileg ellenőrzött.[1]

## Konkrét fordítási / definíciós hibák
A legnyilvánvalóbb: a `spectralNorm` végén `TensorError.mustBeSq` szerepel, de a `TensorError` típusban csak `mustBeSquare` van, tehát ez „unknown constructor/field” jellegű hiba lesz.[1]

Van egy másik biztos hiba:  
`theorem add_data_size (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape.equals b shape = true) : ...` sorban `b shape` elgépelés, ott `b.shape` kellene, különben parser/névfeloldási hiba.[1]

Ezen felül több állításod nem is jól típusozott Leanben a jelen formájában (pl. `reshape_ok`-ban `h1 : new_shape.length > 0` mellett te `simp [reshape, h1, h2]`-t használsz, de a definícióban `new_shape.length == 0` szerepel Bool-ként; általában át kell hidalni a Prop/Bools különbséget, vagy eleve Prop-os feltételekkel dolgozni).[1]

## „Szimulált” tensor műveletek, nem specifikáció + bizonyítás
Sok operációnál a visszaadott `data` egyszerűen nullákkal van feltöltve (pl. `sum/max/min/argmax/argmin/broadcast/slice/concat/stack/pad/tile/conv2d`), ami implementációként is csak placeholder: a shape-számítás többnyire megtörténik, de az értékek nem a matematikai művelet eredményei.[3]

Az ilyen definíciók mellé persze lehet formális bizonyítást írni „shape-invariánsokra” (pl. hogy a `data.size` tényleg `totalSize`), de jelenleg ez sincs végig bizonyítva, és több helyen épp ez van `sorry`-val kitakarva.[1]

## Mitől lenne „valós” formális verifikáció?
Akkor mondható annak, ha (1) minden `sorry` eltűnik, (2) a definíciók tényleg a kívánt szemantikát implementálják (nem csak 0-kkal töltött tömböt adnak vissza), és (3) a fontos specifikációkat tételként bizonyítod (pl. `reshape` megőrzi az elemeket, `add` elemenkénti összeadás és a méretek egyeznek, `computeIndex` helyessége a stride-okhoz képest, stb.).[1]

Ha megírod, pontosan mire szeretnéd a verifikációt (csak shape-bizonyítások? vagy érték-szemantika is?), tudok javasolni egy minimális, *tényleg bizonyítható* specifikációs réteget (pl. `Tensor` mint `Fin (totalSize shape) → Float`), és onnan levezetni az Array-alapú implementáció helyességét.
